# ClinGene - Clinical Genetic Testing & Precision Genomics

> ClinGene is a premier genetic testing laboratory and bioinformatics facility based in Islamabad, Pakistan. Providing Sanger sequencing, next-generation sequencing (NGS), and bioinformatics solutions.

## Core Services

- [Clinical Genetic Testing](https://www.clingene.co/services): Comprehensive diagnostic panels, Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), and genetic counseling.
- [Genomic Sequencing](https://www.clingene.co/services): NGS, Sanger sequencing, RNA-Seq, and metagenomic analysis.
- [Bioinformatics Services](https://www.clingene.co/services): Phylogenetic analysis, molecular docking, protein modeling, and custom computational workflows.

## Organization Information

- [About Us](https://www.clingene.co/about): Company mission, executive team, accreditations (SECP CUIN: 0363023, FBR: K555253).
- [Scientific Leadership & Team](https://www.clingene.co/team): Profiles of clinical geneticists, postdocs, and laboratory scientists.
- [Research & Publications](https://www.clingene.co/research): Published peer-reviewed research and ongoing clinical projects.
- [Careers](https://www.clingene.co/careers): Open positions and application portal.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://www.clingene.co/contact): Laboratory contact information, location, and inquiry form.
